critical_code_review_comments: Refactor cleanly extracted CreateUserDialog (282), PermissionsDialog (105), ResetPasswordDialog (114), CollegeCard (105), CollegeFormDialog (162), BulkUploadDialog (171), ScheduleDialog (92), and PasteReviewStep (265) — all under 300 lines and self-contained. Parent pages dropped from 698→254 (Users), 627→245 (Colleges), 506→478 (StudentDetail), 442→210 (PasteApplicationDialog).

All data-testid props were preserved verbatim from pre-refactor — verified by spot-checking grep output against review request's expected ids. Note: original codebase uses 'users-tab-<value>' (not 'tab-<value>') and 'perm-save'/'perm-reset' (not 'permissions-save'/'permissions-reset') — review request had slightly drifted testid names; actual code & tests align.
Two benign console 401s on initial load (likely /api/users/me or /api/notifications polled before auth cookie attaches) — pre-existing, not caused by refactor. No pageerror or uncaught exceptions.
Dev-mode 'ResizeObserver loop completed' overlay appeared once during testing — known benign React dev-server warning, not a bug.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (22/22 flows verified, 1 N/A due to seed data)
